mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_REQUEST ( EXECUTION_ID, REQUEST_SEQUENCE, COMBINATION_NO, PAGE_NO, ORIGINAL_REQUEST_ID, REQUEST_METHOD, REQUEST_URL, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{executionId}, #{requestSequence}, #{combinationNo}, #{pageNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{originalRequestId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_REQUEST_PARAM ( REQUEST_ID, PARAM_LOCATION, PARAM_NAME, PARAM_VALUE, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{paramLocation}, #{paramName}, #{paramValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_PARAM_ID, REQUEST_ID, PARAM_LOCATION, PARAM_NAME, PARAM_VALUE, CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_EXTERNAL_API_REQUEST_PARAM WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY REQUEST_PARAM_ID
